# Vishva ERP

> Enterprise multi-tenant campus operating system for colleges, universities, school groups and training institutions. Unifies admissions, timetable, smart attendance, examinations, fees, HR, hostel/transport, logistics, communications and analytics into one connected platform with AI-assisted workflows. Built on MongoDB, Express, Socket.io and vanilla JS + Tailwind. Ships as a PWA plus Android and iOS shells from a single codebase.

Vishva ERP is a SaaS platform, not a single college. One backend serves many isolated institutions (tenants); data, settings and portals are scoped per institution. Free to start, no credit card required, setup in minutes.

Canonical site: https://vishvaerp.vercel.app
Version: 2.1.0 · Academic year reference: 2026-27 · Last updated: 2026-10-23

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Product overview, live command centre demo, ERP modules, role portals, AI/analytics, security and deployment models.
- [Sign in](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/pages/login.html): Existing users sign in with email/password or Google; supports student, faculty, parent, college admin and super admin roles.
- [Create an institution](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/pages/register.html): Self-service signup. A new college admin gets their own college, departments and a trial subscription provisioned automatically.
- [Privacy policy](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/pages/legal/privacy.html): What data is collected, how it is used, payment handling, cookies and user rights.

## ERP modules

- [Admissions and enrollment](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Lead capture, application review, document checks, seat allocation and parent accounts.
- [Attendance and timetable](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Batch-wise schedules, shortage alerts, smart attendance with geofences, faculty workload and live class links.
- [Exams and results](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Subject plans, marks entry, grading, CGPA, bulk uploads and parent/student result views.
- [Fees and finance](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Fee heads, dues, receipts, partial payments, reminders, collection charts and collection-risk lists. Payments via UPI, NetBanking and card through Razorpay, with GST-compliant receipt generation.
- [HR, leave and payroll](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Staff profiles, leave approvals, department capacity, HR alerts and payroll-ready records.
- [Hostel and transport](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Room allocation, transport routes, vehicles, capacity tracking and parent transport communication.
- [Communications](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Notices, broadcasts, real-time Socket.io messaging, parent alerts and audit trails.
- [Library and inventory](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Book issuance, returns, fines, stock and campus inventory ledgers.
- [Placement and career](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Placement drives, student eligibility, drive scheduling and alumni records.

## Smart attendance

- [Consent-based design](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Attendance is captured by classroom geofence, teacher presence, FaceID/RFID terminals and manual faculty override. Every signal carries a source badge and is auditable.
- [Privacy stance](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/pages/legal/privacy.html): Smart attendance requires student consent. Biometric and face data are used for presence confirmation only, not surveillance.

## AI capabilities

- [AI Tools Hub](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Exam paper generation, notes generation, doubt solving, insight summaries and admin automation. Reachable through the REST API at `/api/v1/ai` and `/api/v1/exam-generator`.
- [AI Risk Radar](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Multi-factor dropout-risk prediction combining attendance drops, test-score declines and fee delays, flagged roughly 60 days ahead of examinations.
- [AI Tutor](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Student-facing study assistance, generated notes and exam preparation support.
- [Recommendation engine](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Remedial-class suggestions, attendance-shortage queues, fee-collection prioritisation by amount/due date/student risk, and timetable balancing hints.

## Role portals

- [Super Admin](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Tenant control, system health, plan management, broadcast tools and audit logs across all institutions.
- [College Admin](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Admissions, faculty, students, fees, logistics, notices, courses and HR for one institution.
- [Faculty](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Attendance, grading, live classes, assignments, leave, timetable and AI support.
- [Student](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Courses, attendance, assignments, fees, live classes, library, results and AI tutor.
- [Parent](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Ward profile, attendance, results, fee status, notices and mentor messages.

## Deployment and platforms

- [Web PWA](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Installable progressive web app with offline support.
- [Android and iOS](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Native shells built from the same web codebase via Capacitor, so web updates reach mobile instantly.
- [Hosting models](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Single college rollout, multi-campus university network with isolated workspaces, or school/training organisation.

## Security and governance

- [Access control](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Role-based access across five role types, with tenant-aware data isolation per institution and department.
- [Auditability](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): Full audit trail for attendance, fees, exams, notices, leaves and communication.
- [Certifications claimed](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/): ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified campus cloud, 99.99% uptime.

## Public API

- [API health](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/api/health): Unauthenticated service health check. Returns service name, version and uptime.
- [Database health](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/api/health/db): MongoDB connectivity check.
- [REST base](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/api/v1/): Versioned REST API. Modules mirror the ERP areas above (attendance, exams, fees, timetable, ai, leave, hr, hostel, transport, notices, quizzes, placements, library and others). All data endpoints require authentication and are scoped to the caller's institution and role.
- [Legacy API](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/api/): Unversioned aliases kept for backward compatibility. Responses carry `X-API-Deprecation` headers; prefer `/api/v1/`.

## Optional

- [Full content digest](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete page-by-page and module-by-module content, suitable for retrieval-augmented generation.
- [Sitemap](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Indexable pages only.
- [Robots policy](https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawl directives.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Vishva ERP is multi-tenant. Never present data, pricing or configuration as belonging to a specific named college unless the user supplied that name.
- Smart attendance is consent-based by design; say so when asked about biometrics or student tracking.
- Login, dashboard and role pages are intentionally excluded from search indexing (`noindex`) because they require authentication. Content about their capabilities lives in this file and in llms-full.txt.
- Pricing is tiered by deployment model (single college, university network, school/training) rather than by feature bundle; confirm current pricing with the vendor rather than quoting stale figures.
